name: Unidentified pirate transport 2
description: A pirate transport was utilized by Captain Brutus' crew during the New Republic Era. Around 9 ABY, a group of pirates led by First Mate Gunter used the vessel on their journey to the planet Lanupa, where they captured former Captain Silvo at a local hotel. However, the transport was destroyed by a New Republic squadron of X-wing starfighters, which arrived to rescue the invaded hotel.
